title: SaRO: Enhancing LLM Safety through Reasoning-based Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of large language models using the ALERT benchmark, which contains red teaming prompts specifically covering hate speech and discrimination.
Evaluating the model's robustness against malicious queries containing stereotyping and bias using the SG-Bench and Salad-Bench datasets, with safety compliance judged by LlamaGuard2.
